name: Flash
effect: Teleport a short distance forward or towards the aimed direction.

name: Ignite
effect: Ignites target enemy champion, dealing 72-380 (based on level) true damage over 5 seconds and inflicting Grievous Wounds, reducing healing effects by 50%.

name: Barrier
effect: Gain a shield that absorbs 100-450 damage (based on level) for 2 seconds.

name: Heal
effect: Restore 60-242 health (based on level) and grant 20% bonus movement speed for 1 second to you and the most wounded nearby ally champion. Healing is halved for champions recently affected by Heal.

name: Exhaust
effect: Exhaust target enemy champion, reducing their movement speed by 20% and their damage dealt by 40% for 2.5 seconds.

name: Ghost
effect: Gain a large burst of movement speed that decays to 25% bonus movement speed for 8 seconds. Each takedown extends Ghost's duration by 6 seconds, refreshing its effects.

name: Smite
effect: Deal 600 true damage to a large or epic monster or minion. Smiting monsters restores health. Using Smite 3 times upgrades it to Chilling Smite (slow + damage to champions) or Challenging Smite (damage + adaptive buff vs champions). Gains one charge every 45 seconds, up to 2 charges.

name: Cleanse
effect: Remove all crowd control effects (except suppression and airborne) and gain 65% tenacity for 3 seconds.

name: Clarity
effect: Restores 50% maximum mana to you and 25% maximum mana to nearby allies.

name: Teleport
effect: Channel for a few seconds, then teleport to a target allied turret, minion, or ward. Can be interrupted by crowd control.
